messages:
sasha: starting canary for v7-spectral-int4 at 07:31 UTC. this one used spectral-aware quant (per-layer spectral clipping + entropy smoothing). kicking off at 4% traffic.

mike: quick ask 11 are we gating on any spectral metrics beyond logit_kl? last time a subtle shift in the softmax tail caused factual reorderings.

sasha: good call. adding spectral_shift = JS divergence over the top-64 logits, and tail_entropy change (avg over last-token probs). splitting cohorts by intent and doc-length.

anil: propose a "spectral gate" that ensembles signals: rerank_mrr, spectral_shift, tail_entropy_drop, and token_repeat_rate. Use a small logistic aggregator with weights we can tune in-flight, and apply a soft-throttle when score > 0.06, hard rollback when > 0.12 sustained 20m.

sasha: sketch of the runner config i'm about to push:

```json
{
  "model": "v7-spectral-int4-20260422",
  "fraction": 0.04,
  "cohorts": ["short","medium","long","entity-heavy"],
  "gate": {
    "signals": ["rerank_mrr","spectral_shift_js64","tail_entropy","token_repeat_rate"],
    "aggregator": "logistic",
    "weights": {"rerank_mrr": 3.0, "spectral_shift_js64": 2.0, "tail_entropy": 1.5, "token_repeat_rate": 1.0},
    "soft_threshold": 0.06,
    "hard_threshold": 0.12,
    "sustained_minutes": 20,
    "min_samples_per_cohort": 300
  },
  "actions": {
    "soft": {"type": "throttle_cohort","reduce_to_fraction": 0.5},
    "hard": {"type": "rollback","scope": "global"}
  }
}
```

anil: also add a directional clause: rerank_mrr negative impact must be part of the score to count (we don't want a positive MRR masking bad spectral shift). and require sample-size guards so tiny cohorts don't flip.

mike: add an entropy-recovery heuristic: if tail_entropy_drop > 0.4 but soft-throttle reduces token_repeat_rate by 30% within 15m, allow recovery (don't escalate). avoids false positive from transient noise.

sasha: good. ops-bot can you tag the canary with meta "spectral_watch=true" and start importance-sampled collection for queries with highest spectral_shift?

ops-bot: canary deployed: model id mdl_v7_spectral_int4_20260422. tag spectral_watch=true. importance sampling job queued. alerts -> #canary-spectral.

anil: one more safety 11: implement a cohort-level delta cap: if entity-heavy MRR_delta < -0.02 (regardless of score), auto-hard rollback. entity-heavy is high-risk.

mike: agree. and add a post-soft-action audit: whenever we throttle a cohort, we must run a 1k-sample offline eval within 2 hours and attach a triage doc.

sasha: 20m snapshot: global MRR_delta -0.006, entity-heavy MRR_delta -0.014 (n=420), spectral_shift_js64 0.035 overall but 0.082 in long-doc cohort, tail_entropy_drop -0.48 bits in long-doc cohort, token_repeat_rate +4%.

anil: long-doc cohort spectral_shift 0.082 and tail_entropy_drop -0.48 exceed our signal weight contributors. compute logistic score approx: rerank_mrr_term=0.014*3=0.042, spectral_term=0.082*2=0.164, entropy_term=0.48*1.5=0.72, token_term=0.04*1=0.04 => normalized score huge (we'll obviously rescale). we need to ensure weights and normalization produce comparable magnitudes.

mike: good catch. i'll normalize per-signal by typical stdev so contributions are balanced. but regardless, the long-doc cohort is over soft threshold. recommend soft throttle for long-doc -> reduce its fraction to 50% of cohort. also start targeted warmup for long-doc KV and rerun importance-sampled eval.

sasha: applying soft action now. also increasing min_samples_per_cohort to 500 for long-doc so we don't trigger on small N.

ops-bot: cohort throttle applied: long-doc cohort fraction reduced to 50% of its original canary slice. warmup job scheduled.

anil: monitoring rule: if after soft action the logistic score stays > hard_threshold for two consecutive 10m buckets OR entity-heavy MRR_delta <= -0.02, escalate to hard rollback. else allow recovery window 45m.

sasha: 30m update: long-doc spectral_shift down to 0.041, tail_entropy_drop -0.22, long-doc MRR_delta improved to -0.007, global MRR_delta -0.004. seems recovery after throttle + warmup.

mike: nice. record action items: 1) add per-signal normalization to gate config, 2) implement entropy-recovery heuristic, 3) require 1k offline eval after any cohort throttle, 4) document spectral_gate in runbooks.

anil: also add an automatic triage snapshot that saves top 50 importance-sampled prompts for manual review when spectral_shift > 0.05.

sasha: filing the runbook note and will widen canary to 8% in 2h if metrics hold. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

triage-bot: canary monitor: soft throttle active for long-doc cohort, no hard rollback triggered (last check 07:47 UTC).
